brief: The AI money playbook for solo founders. Six plays that print revenue without scaling a team — productized services, micro-SaaS, info products, AI-augmented agency, paid newsletter, prompt sets.

slots.author: Jordan Lee
slots.headline: The AI Money Playbook for Solo Founders
slots.body: Six plays that print revenue without hiring a team. Use AI to scale your income, not your headcount. Pick one play and start this week.

slots.author: Jordan Lee
slots.title: Productized AI Services
slots.body: Package your expertise into a fixed-price deliverable. Let AI handle 80% of execution. You keep the margin without managing employees.

slots.author: Jordan Lee
slots.title: Build a Micro-SaaS
slots.body: Solve one painful problem for a niche audience. AI reduces build time from months to days. Charge monthly recurring revenue.

slots.author: Jordan Lee
slots.title: Sell AI Info Products
slots.body: Turn your prompts and workflows into templates or courses. AI helps you produce faster. Sell forever with zero marginal cost.

slots.author: Jordan Lee
slots.title: Build an AI Agency
slots.body: Deliver client work at speed with AI copilots. One operator can replace a traditional team. Keep overhead low and profits high.

slots.author: Jordan Lee
slots.title: Curate a Paid Newsletter
slots.body: Aggregate AI insights and trends for busy professionals. A small paid subscriber base beats massive ad-driven audiences. Build once, monetize forever.

slots.author: Jordan Lee
slots.title: Sell Premium Prompt Sets
slots.body: Bundle your best prompts into themed packs. Founders pay for proven systems that save hours. Instant delivery, infinite scale.

slots.author: Jordan Lee
slots.headline: Which Play Will You Run First?
slots.body: Comment your pick below and save this carousel. Follow for more solo founder tactics.
